title: Woman's Body Found in Field After Alleged Honor Killing
summary: A woman named Adila was allegedly killed by her brother, Gulfaam, over a family dispute. The police have granted him a 24-hour custody remand after he was arrested on charges of kidnapping and murder. The investigation revealed that the brother had strangled his sister to death in a field where she was staying with her boyfriend. The police will question him on Monday. Adila's body was found in the field by her family members, who reported it to the police.
